Anchor Boom.Name: Anchor Boom
Anchor Boom.Description:
Directs hits deals {{EffectLink|Criticals}}.
[Held] Fires a {{EffectLink|Burn|burning}} wrecking ball.
Anchor Boom.Quote: The Captain was born to lead, anchorboom in his paws. When his island was absorbed, he decimated the sentinels, plunged the rodents into an unparalleled festive euphoria, and vowed to annihilate anyone intruding upon his macabre party with a single explosive cannonball.
Anchor Boom.Author: Captain

Beatbolt.Name: Beatbolt
Beatbolt.Description: Fire with the right timing to inflict {{EffectLink|Criticals}}.
Beatbolt.Quote: The creator of the Beatbolt was raised and trained in combat by a peaceful sentinel. Under its guidance, he created a unigue weapon whose full potential was revesled only by following a precise rhythm. But one day, the sentinel was rebooted and attacked Thib. The memories of this tragedy now lie within the Vortex.
Beatbolt.Author: Thib

Boomerang.Name: Boomerang
Boomerang.Description: It goes away, and it comes back.
Boomerang.Quote: The scientists’ children did not have much fun when they joined their parents at work. Luckily for Bobby, he had a boomerang to keep himself occupied. When the inevitable happened, the memory of this child and his toy remained forever preserved within the Vortex.
Boomerang.Author: Bobby

Charged Blade.Name: Charged Blade
Charged Blade.Quote: Fitz had only one wish: to cross the clouds. His plan was simple: to create an energy-charged sword that could cut through the skies. However, while attempting it, he was dragded down by the blade's weight and disappeared. Since this memory is in the Vortex, one can surmise that his fall was fatal.
Charged Blade.Author: Fitz

Crocojaws.Name: Crocojaws
Crocojaws.Description: Ancient, sharpened jaws... [Held] Hits activate {{EffectLink|Brutality}} for 4s (+30%).
Crocojaws.Quote: Gab remembers being killed by Leapers. Gab suffered. His entire jaw was torn off. Gab hopes there was a reason for it. Gab did not choose this life. Gab does not even know why he attacks Leapers. Everything is muddled in Gab's head. Gab just hurts. Too much.
Crocojaws.Author: Gab

Cuprik's Hammer.Name: Cuprik's Hammer
Cuprik's Hammer.Quote: The design of the hammer testifies to the genius of its creator: its head, kept at a low temperature, ensures rapid and efficient cooling of metals. However, the very existence of this memory is strange. Sinice Cuprik is still alive... how was this memory absorbed by the Vortex?
Cuprik's Hammer.Author: Cuprik

Elder Sword.Name: Elder Sword
Elder Sword.Description: The last hit throws enemies backward and deals {{EffectLink|Criticals}}.
Elder Sword.Quote: No. Don't give me that sword. I don't want to fight anymore. How many fish did you slaughter to create it? I'm not an accomplice. I'm a victim. My brothers leave me no choice... I have to fight. Alright. If I must, I will destroy everything.
Elder Sword.Author: #94D6D6

Eye Blade.Name: Eye Blade
Eye Blade.Description: The last strike deals {{EffectLink|Criticals}} and applies {{EffectLink|Mark}} (50 damage).
Eye Blade.Quote: Orna opened her many eyes onto a new world. Before that, she was convinced she only had two. Then she realized what they had done to her. What had she become!? A monster. Just a vile monster. Her remories stirred. She would take revenge. Oh yes, she would kill them all.
Eye Blade.Author: Orna

Fiery Claws.Name: Fiery Claws
Fiery Claws.Description:
Deals {{EffectLink|Criticals}} against {{EffectLink|Burn|Burning}} foes.
[Held] Fires 3 homing heads that {{EffectLink|Burn}} (2 damage).
Fiery Claws.Quote: These are his weapons. He knows how to wield them. They were created for him, so that fire would spread, so that he would defend her. Or maybe to test him? His heart burns with indecision. He was meant to be the leader. Now he is defeated, and relieved to have been.
Fiery Claws.Author: #F38707

Fish Knife.Name: Fish Knife
Fish Knife.Description:
Perfect for fish!
Good for adventure?
The last hit is {{EffectLink|Criticals|Critical}}.
Fish Knife.Quote: This knife was designed from a 407-year-old model. Although it is a fish knife, Yua never used it as such. She always offers it as a gift to lonely souls left to fend for themselves in the Vortex.
Fish Knife.Author: Yua

Fishing Rod.Name: Fishing Rod
Fishing Rod.Description:
So, are they biting?
[Held] Hooks an enemy and pulls it behind you.
Fishing Rod.Quote: When he was on the Ark, Carlos spent a lot of time fishing in the ponds. He was such a skilled fisherman that his Fishing rod became his weapon. Getting rid of that memory must not have been easy.
Fishing Rod.Author: Carlos

Golem Flail.Name: Golem Flail
Golem Flail.Quote: When monsters emerged from the Vortex to attack Tef's island, panic spread among the inhabitants. In a burst of adrenaline, the warrior tore off an invader's tail with his bare hands. His act, as brutal as it was improbable, galvanized his pecple, and the attack was repelled. However, the Vortex eventually absorbed the island and the memory of its savior.
Golem Flail.Author: Tef

Goo Brush.Name: Goo Brush
Goo Brush.Quote: This brush belonged to a young painting prodigy forced to turn her art into a weapon. Today, the many frescoes visible on the ships of the Vortex are inspired by her work.
Goo Brush.Author: Sophie

Heavy Blade.Name: Heavy Blade
Heavy Blade.Description: A slow but powerful weapon. The last attack deals {{EffectLink|Criticals}} and stuns.
Heavy Blade.Quote: Araminta was chased from her island because of a simple mistake. While defending it from an invasion, she split it in two with her greatsword. It was a disaster for all its inhabitants, who did not hesitate to exile her. Furious at being expelled, she kept breaking islands until death separated her from her weapon of destruction.
Heavy Blade.Author: Araminta

Hibiki's Umbrella.Name: Hibiki's Umbrella
Hibiki's Umbrella.Description: The last attack unleashes a {{EffectLink|Criticals|Critical}} tornado.
Hibiki's Umbrella.Quote: Lost in the Vortex, searching for his people, Ryoga glided between islands using his umbrella until he lost his grip. He fell into the sea of clouds and disappeared forever. Even though it is only a menory, it is still possible to hear his screams of anger from here.
Hibiki's Umbrella.Author: Ryoga

Impactone.Name: Impactone
Impactone.Description:
The weapon of a relentless and deadly Sentinel.
The last hit deals {{EffectLink|Criticals}}.
Impactone.Quote: When Ruby was created, before the thousands of copies of her, she was incredibly proud of her Impactone. After all, such a lethal weapon deserved to be on her arm. However, she hated staining it with blood. Even if her programming insisted, her pacifism always won out. Thanks to that, this weapon is yours today.
Impactone.Author: Ruby

Jar.Name: Jar
Jar.Quote: Much like his colleagues, Francis loves to make a profit. This leads to his idea of crafting a weapon that takes advantage of its wielder's shells. Since Francis is better at talking than at crafting, he crudely modifies a jar into a device that can throw shells, allowing him to collect them afterwards.
Jar.Author: Francis

Katars.Name: Katars
Katars.Quote: Sornetimes, the most precious memory is that of a first weapon. For Bidju, that is the case. He was just another grunt, but his katars were his creation, the apple of his eye. He crossed the Vortex barrier with them... What happened over there, again? How did he manage to...? Hmm...
Katars.Author: Bidju

Kunai.Name: Kunai
Kunai.Quote: Lucas had a R4RITY altar. He kept giving it Cogs. He couldn’t help himself. It itched. One day, the altar offered him kunai as thanks. They carried a curse equal to Lucas's obsession with the altar. Only modern Leapers know their usefulness.
Kunai.Author: Lucas

Ninja Stars.Name: Ninja Stars
Ninja Stars.Description: Damage based on distance. Inflicts {{EffectLink|Criticals}} when used from max range.
Ninja Stars.Quote: On her Ark, Hinamorie had a choice between several paths, and since she did not enjoy fighting, she opted for the art of performance instead. In a world like theirs, everyone needed a bit of entertainment. Throwing ninja stars was her signature act. She ended her career in style: a star embedded in her skull.
Ninja Stars.Author: Hinamorie

Ravenblade.Name: Ravenblade
Ravenblade.Description:
Deals {{EffectLink|Criticals}} after the 3rd strike.
[Held] Jump attack.
Ravenblade.Quote: He had finally found a weapon that would eradicate her. He would save the world from the Vortex and restore balance. This giant feather that had come from beneath the sea of clouds had everything needed to kill her... Everything was perfect. Why did he fail? WHY?
Ravenblade.Author: Lucien

Sentinel Wings.Name: Sentinel Wings
Sentinel Wings.Description:
Fly me to the moon ♫
Fires mid-range lasers.
Sentinel Wings.Quote: Like many anisapiens of the Ark, Sabrian had followed Carlos. As she watched Nelume transform into obsidian, a sentinel attacked them. Without hesitation, Sabrian tore off its wings and turned its power against itself. Sabrian's statue has likely shattered since then.
Sentinel Wings.Author: Sabrian

Sharp Sisters.Name: Sharp Sisters
Sharp Sisters.Quote: In his eyes, he will serve her until his death. Again and again. For eternity if necessary. She is his reason for being. He will always protect the Vortex. If he must kill his brothers for her, just as she created these weapons for him, he will do it with pleasure. Yes. He is their greatest threat. In truth, he has no brothers, only sisters.
Sharp Sisters.Author: #82D626

Shield.Name: Shield
Shield.Description:
Reduces damage taken when held in hand.
[Held] Raise your {{EffectLink|Guard|guard|noImg=t}} to block and {{EffectLink|Parry|parry}} enemy attacks.
Shield.Quote: At one time, Skool was the only anisapien in the Vortex Ring. The fish offered him a shield to fight the sentinels that attacked him. Skool was a seasoned survivalist, but he did not wish to harm anyone. He never used it as a weapon, only as a means of defense. He failed, like many others.
Shield.Author: Skool

Sirocco.Name: Sirocco
Sirocco.Description: Deals {{EffectLink|Criticals}} against {{EffectLink|Burn|Burning}} targets. The last strike applies {{EffectLink|Burn}} (2 damage).
Sirocco.Quote: The Sirocco is a weapon that Frieren designed to channel her magic, but in truth, Frieren is not originally from the Vortex. It seems the last spell she learned from that old merchant did not work as intended. What is this unpleasant place? There is far too much wind here... Let's hurry home
Sirocco.Author: Frieren

Spinalsword.Name: Spinalsword
Spinalsword.Description: The death of nearby enemy activates its {{EffectLink|Criticals}} and grants +25% {{EffectLink|Attack speed}} for 8s.
Spinalsword.Quote: When monsters first appeared in the Vortex Ring, Wan saw an opportunity. She dedicated her life to studying them, learning their behavior and origins. The Spinalsword is the culmimation of her research: a faithful reconstruction of a monster's spine.
Spinalsword.Author: Wan

Telepike.Name: Telepike
Telepike.Description:
Tip deals {{EffectLink|Criticals}}.
[Held] Teleports to the target.
Telepike.Quote: The memories linked to the creation of the Telepike date back to before the discovery of air currents. To travel between islands, the famous Kalarion designed a motorized launch system that propelled its wielders into the skies. Very effective, but not without danger. The search for his remains has long since been abandoned.
Telepike.Author: Kalarion

Worm Claws.Name: Worm Claws
Worm Claws.Description: Deals {{EffectLink|Corrosive}} damage. [Held] Each hit also deals {{EffectLink|Corrosive}} damage over time.
Worm Claws.Quote: Shallan's passion was eating absolutely everything. She had an iron stomach and a particular fondness for the dangerous monsters inhabiting certain islands. Her last meal was also her most ambitious. Only the monster's corrosive mandibles remained. Shallan, meanwhile, died of poisoning.
Worm Claws.Author: Shallan
